_note: Evidence against the Doctrine's version of events (src/world/evidence.gd). Found evidence is the story flag 'evidence:<id>'. Hand it out with an anchor action (evidence <id>), a mission's story_flags_on_win, or a quest's reward_flags. NPCs react through their evidence_talk entries (NPCS tab).

quota_memo.title: The Quota Memo
quota_memo.description: A foreman's memo: 'Accidents are to be logged as voluntary overtime.' Signed, initialled, stamped twice.

shift_roster.title: Doctored Shift Roster
shift_roster.description: Two rosters for the same night. In one, nine workers clocked in. In the other, the one sent upstairs, six did.

casualty_ledger.title: Casualty Ledger
casualty_ledger.description: Border casualty figures, before and after 'reconciliation'. The before column is longer. Much longer.

storm_drain_tapes.title: Storm Drain Tapes
storm_drain_tapes.description: Waterlogged audio reels: a Cantor rehearsing tomorrow's 'spontaneous' crowd chant.

hymn_rewrites.title: Hymn Rewrites
hymn_rewrites.description: Hymn sheets with last week's verses crossed out and the war's 'new' start date written in.

kade_form.title: Form CH-1: Ward Re-registration
kade_form.description: A Ministry of Clear History form. 'Family name of record (all residents): KADE. Prior names: — (struck for clarity).' The stamp is older than the Republic.
